description: Defines data structures, enums, and classes related to CSI-RS (Channel State Information Reference Signals) configuration in 5G NR, including resource mapping, periodicity, and resource set configurations.

classes.name: ocudu::csi_rs_resource_mapping
classes.description: Configures resource element mapping for CSI-RS in time and frequency domains.

classes.name: ocudu::nzp_csi_rs_resource
classes.description: Configures Non-Zero-Power CSI-RS resources transmitted in the cell.

classes.name: ocudu::nzp_csi_rs_resource_set
classes.description: Set of NZP-CSI-RS resources with set-specific parameters.

classes.name: ocudu::csi_im_resource_element_pattern
classes.description: Pattern of resource element occupancy for CSI-IM resources.

classes.name: ocudu::csi_ssb_resource_set
classes.description: Resource set referring to SS/PBCH blocks for CSI.

classes.name: ocudu::csi_associated_report_config_info
classes.description: Associates report configurations with CSI resources.

classes.name: ocudu::csi_aperiodic_trigger_state
classes.description: Configures trigger states for aperiodic CSI reporting.

classes.name: ocudu::csi_meas_config
classes.description: Main configuration structure for CSI-RS and related resources.

methods.name: csi_resource_periodicity_to_uint
methods.description: Converts CSI resource periodicity enum to unsigned integer.

methods.name: csi_resource_periodicity_options
methods.description: Returns available options for CSI resource periodicity.
